I therefore prioritized matched local curves and low-ratio anchors, while retaining basic and donor probes for known structural failure regions.","batch_rationale":"The batch contains five basic or fused-nitrogen probes, a four-point nitrobenzophenone/benzophenone boundary set, matched m99 and m125 response curves, seven donor-family contrasts, additional carbonyl and aldehyde tail probes, two compact heavy-halogen anchors, and a three-point m100 solvent-ratio curve.
